extraction_method: Chrome DevTools MCP. Opened https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard, which redirects to https://arena.ai/leaderboard (same product). list_network_requests showed no separate leaderboard JSON API: the data ships inside the Next.js RSC flight payload of each /leaderboard/{arena}/{category} route. Those exact requests were then re-issued from the page context with fetch(url, {headers:{RSC:"1"}}); the "leaderboard":{...} object was brace-matched out of each payload and JSON.parsed verbatim. The agent arena uses a different shape ("snapshot":{lastUpdated,totalSessions,totalObservations,modelCount,rows,signals}) and was extracted the same way. Factuality ratings came from GET /nextjs-api/factuality/ratings?arenaSlug=text&category={cat}, a plain JSON endpoint discovered by watching network traffic while clicking the Factuality radio in the UI.
notes: lmarena.ai now redirects to arena.ai. source_url is kept as the requested lmarena.ai URL; per-record source_url points at the live arena.ai page.
No login, CAPTCHA or Cloudflare interstitial was encountered. The leaderboard is fully public.

Verification that the fetch-based reads match what the browser rendered: the DOM table on /leaderboard/text showed rank 1 claude-fable-5, score 1508, +-5, 27.013k votes, $10/$50, 1M context; the fetched payload for text|overall|style_control gives rating 1507.5857493966353 (rounds to 1508), ratingLower/Upper 1502.61/1512.56 (+-5), votes 27013, inputPricePerMillion 10, outputPricePerMillion 50, contextLength 1000000. Clicking the None radio in the DOM navigated to /leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control and produced top model claude-opus-5-max at 1504, matching the fetched raw variant.

The ranking-mode control has three options: Style Control, Factuality, None. URL suffix "-no-style-control" returns the raw (styleControl:false) leaderboard. Both style_control and raw variants were captured for the text and vision arenas. The document and search arenas declare hasStyleControl:true but their pages already serve styleControl:false and expose no style-control URL, so only the raw variant exists for them. All remaining arenas have hasStyleControl:false, so their single variant is labelled "raw".

Factuality is not a leaderboard but a penalty-weight sweep (weights 0/25/50/75/100) giving rating/ratingLower/ratingUpper/rankLower/rankUpper per model key. It is stored verbatim in raw.json under factuality_text_ratings for all 29 text categories, but is NOT expanded into normalized.json because it has no single canonical score per model. It is only served for the text arena; vision returned {}.

Every value in normalized.json is copied verbatim from the site payload. Fields the site does not provide (votes for the agent arena, context_window and pricing for many image/video models, dates for arenas without voteCutoffISOString) are omitted, never estimated.

Each fetched payload was validated against the requested arena slug, category and styleControl flag before being stored; mismatches were rejected rather than saved. All leaderboards in this file passed that check.

Arena route slugs differ from arena slugs: image-to-code -> /leaderboard/code/image-to-webdev, video-to-video -> /leaderboard/video-edit. The code arena (WebDev) uses internal leaderboard ids prefixed "webdev".
ci for standard arenas is the absolute rating interval {lower, upper} from ratingLower/ratingUpper. The agent arena only publishes a symmetric half-width, stored as {half_width}.
Non-spec fields kept because the task asked for the underlying data: model_key, rank_upper, rank_lower, style_control, model_url, and (agent only) sessions / observations.
